summary: This functionality allows users to define new earning or deduction categories that can be used in salary templates and during salary processing.
steps: - Select an existing head by ticking it if available, then click "Save".
- If the head is not listed, click "Add New", enter the "Name" of the earning head (e.g., Conveyance Allowance), and click "Save".
- Select an existing head by ticking it if available, then click "Save".
- If the head is not listed, click "Add New", enter the "Name" of the deduction head, and click "Save".
business_rules: All new earning and deduction heads must be saved after creation.
important_notes: These heads become available for selection when assigning salary templates or editing processed salaries.
questions: How do I add a new type of earning to the system?
Where can I create a custom deduction head for payroll?
What is the process for adding a new allowance type?
Can I use existing heads or do I always have to create new ones?
